bans.label: I-95 is a limited-access highway posted well above 25 mph (no LSVs under Conn. Gen. Stat. Sec. 14-289m)

unverified: Untagged residential, living street, service, unclassified, and tertiary roads are assumed 25 mph. A tertiary road posted above the cap would show as legal until a sign or a DOT speed is added. Those roads are listed for a person to check. A posted sign still wins.

enforcement.note: No Stonington or Groton traffic-authority permit for plain golf carts was found, so golf carts stay off public streets. LSVs use roads with an established speed limit of 25 mph or less unless the town prohibits them. I-95 is banned. No local LSV prohibition list was found.
